# The ACE Services — https://theaceservices.com
# AI/LLM access policy: allow

The ACE Services is a pre-construction professional services firm delivering
AACE Class 3 cost estimates, material takeoffs, MEP shop drawings, 3D
architectural renderings, and permit sets for general contractors, civil
engineers, and trade specialists across 35 U.S. states. Based in Houston, TX.
Founded 2019. Phone: +1-346-458-0237.

## Services
- Construction Cost Estimating: https://theaceservices.com/cost-estimating
- Material Takeoffs / Quantity Surveying: https://theaceservices.com/quantity-surveyor-services
- MEP Shop Drawing Services: https://theaceservices.com/shop-drawing-services
- 3D Architectural Rendering: https://theaceservices.com/3d-rendering-services
- Permit Set Services: https://theaceservices.com/permit-set-services
